title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Issue of Whether the People's Procuratorate Shall Perform Pre-litigation Announcement Procedures When Filing a Criminal Incidental Civil Public Interest Litigation

articles.content_en:
November 25, 2019
Supreme People's Court & Supreme People's Procuratorate
Reply on the Issue of Whether a People's Procuratorate Shall Perform the Pre-litigation Announcement Procedure
When Instituting a Criminal Incidental Civil Public Interest Litigation
Fa Shi [2019] No. 18
Higher People's Courts and People's Procuratorates of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court and Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region and the People's Procuratorate of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:
Recently, some Higher People's Courts and provincial People's Procuratorates have requested instructions on whether a People's Procuratorate shall perform the pre-litigation announcement procedure when instituting a criminal incidental civil public interest litigation. Upon deliberation, the reply is as follows:
When a People's Procuratorate institutes a criminal incidental civil public interest litigation, it shall perform the pre-litigation announcement procedure. If the pre-litigation announcement procedure has not been performed, the People's Court shall provide clarification and inform the People's Procuratorate to make an announcement before instituting the litigation.
If performing the pre-litigation announcement procedure by the People's Procuratorate may affect the trial period of the relevant criminal case, the People's Procuratorate may separately institute a civil public interest litigation.
This reply is hereby given.
